items.title: Correct the earlier-past form
items.instructions: Correct the verb phrase that should mark the earlier event.

payload.erroneous_sentence: By the time the doors opened, the team prepared every chair.
payload.corrected_sentence: By the time the doors opened, the team had prepared every chair.
payload.explanation: Had prepared places the preparation before the later opening.

items.title: Order events by time
items.instructions: Arrange the event clauses from earliest to latest.

segments.text: The host had tested the microphone.

payload.explanation: Testing occurred before entry, and the talk began after the guests entered.

items.title: Listen for earlier events
items.instructions: Use the transcript as a listening script and identify both earlier actions.

payload.transcript: Before Jo arrived, I had printed the schedule and had placed copies by the door. Jo then welcomed the visitors.

questions.text: Which two actions were complete before Jo arrived?

answers.answer: Printing the schedule and placing copies by the door.

items.title: Write a two-stage narrative
items.instructions: Write a short account that clearly relates earlier and later past events.

payload.communicative_goal: Show preparation completed before a meeting started.
constraints: Use at least one correct past-perfect form.
payload.expected_output: A coherent account with an unambiguous earlier-past relationship.

rubric.criterion: Past perfect marks an event earlier than a stated past point.
The events connect in a logical narrative.

items.title: Identify a possible weak form
items.instructions: Choose the function word that may be reduced when it is unstressed.

payload.explanation: Unstressed had may be reduced, while the prominent content word remains clear.
